children.name: Labs / Description
children.text: The most useful ideas often begin with something a radiologist notices. We work with you to explore it, build it and bring it toward clinical practice.

children.name: Answer
children.text: Start with an observation from your practice. Together, define the clinical question, build a focused tool and test its value.

children.name: Scope / Meaning
children.text: From a specific clinical question to models that learn across imaging data. Each collaboration begins with a defined intended use, dataset and validation plan.
